artifacts.summary: Promoted the succ/pred characterization of X/Y into the generic clause layer and re-bodied all five base-language copies as one-line instances of it.

completion_data.completion_summary: FormalSystem/Semantics/TemporalRules.lean gained a generic next_iff_succ/prev_iff_pred pair over TruthEnv + UntlClause/SnceClause, with no attribute and no new import. All four SourceLanguage declarations and Metalogic.truthAt_next_iff were re-bodied as one-line applications of the generic pair with every name and statement byte-identical, sat_iff and truthAt_next_iterate re-proving verbatim and both C14 axiom pins unmoved. Every documentation surface recording the duplication as deliberate and unresolved now states the clause-layer design.

sapience_notes.subject: Lean clause-layer promotion is the cheap fix for a duplicated truth lemma blocked by an upward import
sapience_notes.value: In BimodalLogic, SentenceTruth.lean's docstring recorded its next/prev duplication with Metalogic/DiscreteNonCompactness.lean as deliberate and unresolved because consolidating would need an upward layer-1 -> Metalogic import. The actual resolution needed no upward edge at all: state the fact generically over the TruthEnv/UntlClause clause layer in Semantics/TemporalRules.lean (layer 1) and re-body both copies as its instances. A recorded 'blocked by layering' note is worth re-testing whenever an abstraction layer has been added since the note was written.

sapience_notes.subject: Re-body, never delete-and-repoint, when a specialized copy feeds a simp set or an axiom pin
sapience_notes.value: Measured in BimodalLogic: SourceLanguage.sat_iff consumes next_iff_covBy/prev_iff_covBy as simp lemmas whose LHS is TruthAt … (Formula.next …), which the generic clause-layer LHS TruthEnv.T … (TemporalRules.next φ) does not syntactically match, so deleting the specialized names would break sat_iff even though the facts are identical. Independently, truthAt_next_iff/truthAt_next_iterate are pinned by fully qualified name against exact #print axioms strings at scripts/check-module-invariants.sh:2316-2317. Re-bodying keeps both surfaces intact; deletion breaks both.

sapience_notes.subject: Promoting a Lean proof to a generic statement can shrink the axiom profile
sapience_notes.value: Re-bodying FormalSystem.SourceLanguage.next_iff_covBy/prev_iff_covBy as instances of the generic TemporalRules.next_iff/prev_iff dropped Quot.sound: [propext, Quot.sound] -> [propext]. The cause is the tactic route, not the statement -- the specialized proofs used simp only [Formula.next, Truth.untl_iff, Truth.bot_false] while the generic one rewrites with the clause lemma directly. The succ forms stayed at [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]. Worth measuring per declaration after any re-body, since an improvement no baseline pins is free and a regression against a pinned one is a hard stop.

sapience_notes.subject: The 'no code changed, only docstrings' diff check in common use is a false-positive generator
sapience_notes.value: The idiom git diff -U0 -- '*.lean' | grep '^+' | grep -vE '^\+\s*(--|/-|\*|-\)|$)' allowlists only comment-OPENER prefixes, so every continuation line inside an existing /-! … -/ or /-- … -/ block is reported as added code. A sound replacement: strip nested /- -/ and -- comments from each changed file at HEAD and in the working tree and compare the remainders -- that showed zero non-comment difference across three files the grep flagged.

sapience_notes.subject: lake-build-guard.sh's result record is key=value, not JSON, and is the reliable way to get a build's PID
sapience_notes.value: <root>/.lake/build-guard.result is newline-separated key=value (state=, holder_pid=, exit_status=, pre/post_fingerprint=, scope_key=). Parsing it with json.load returns nothing and silently yields an empty holder_pid, which makes a kill -0 waiter exit immediately and look like WRITER_EXITED on a still-running build. Read it with grep '^holder_pid=' | cut -d= -f2. Separately, --no-share forces a genuine build rather than a replayed result, which matters when a final verdict must be a real run.

sapience_notes.subject: verify-touched.sh's red is not automatically the calling task's red
sapience_notes.value: Confirmed again in BimodalLogic: a task touching 11 files had verify-touched.sh select 102 touched paths (it derives them from the whole working tree plus the committed diff against its own determined base, not from the task's modified_files) and run 95 suites. The one NEW failure, test-deploy-baseline-lib.sh, was attributable to the repository having no agent-system/ source store at all -- .claude/ is gitignored there, so the failing suite is in no commit of the task. Attribution has to be checked against the task's own modified_files before a scoped run's red is treated as the task's.

sapience_notes.subject: Capture a moving gate baseline from a detached worktree at the task's base commit, not from a prior dispatch's note
sapience_notes.value: readme-lint.sh in BimodalLogic exits 1 at baseline, so its acceptance criterion is set equality of the new-stale finding set, not exit 0. Measuring that set at the base commit via git worktree add --detach <base> and diffing against scripts/readme-date-baseline.txt reproduced the predicted 7 directories exactly, and the same worktree confirmed check-module-invariants.sh --emit-inventory --check PASSed there. Under a multi-task batch a sibling can move either quantity between dispatches, so inheriting an earlier dispatch's number is unsafe.

sapience_notes.subject: A fresh, ungrandfathered README stamp is mandatory work, not hygiene, and bumping a grandfathered one is a one-way loss
sapience_notes.value: BimodalLogic's readme-lint.sh compares each README's *Last verified:* stamp against git log -1 --format=%cs -- <dir>, with scripts/readme-date-baseline.txt grandfathering known-stale rows. Touching a directory whose README is currently fresh and absent from that baseline creates a genuine new finding unless the stamp is bumped; refreshing a grandfathered stamp permanently un-grandfathers that row and turns it into a PRUNE: candidate with no gate benefit. Two bumps were mandatory here (SourceLanguage, NomicLanguage) and three were deliberately left alone.
